from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Paper(BaseModel):
    """A document parsed from the collection, identified by its title and the titles it references."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The full title of this paper as written in the document")
    references: list[str] | None = Field(description="List of paper titles found in the bibliography of this document. These may include external works not in the provided collection.")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """Aggregation of all parsed papers from the document collection."""
    papers: list[Paper]
